aboutP1: Dziko ili likuonetsa mipingo ya Katolika, machapeli, malo oyera, mabasilika ndi makatedrale {n}. Zimachokera ku {a1}zambiri za malo za Overture Maps{end} (mtundu {release}), zomwe zimasonkhanitsa malo kuchokera ku Meta, Microsoft ndi magwero ena otseguka.
aboutP2: Mwa izi, malo {cat} alembedwa mu Overture ngati malo opembedzera a Roma Katolika. Ena {name} alembedwa ngati malo opembedzera a Chikhristu okha, ndipo aphatikizidwa chifukwa mayina awo akuonetsa bwino kuti ndi a Katolika (mwachitsanzo “Parroquia”, “Paróquia”, “Basilica”, “Nossa Senhora”). Tsatanetsatane wawo ali ndi chidziwitso.
aboutP3: Palibe zambiri zotseguka zomwe zili ndi maparishi onse. Zambiri ndi zochuluka ku Amereka ndi Kumadzulo kwa Ulaya, ndipo ndi zochepa m'madera ena a Afirika ndi Asia, kumene maparishi ambiri sanafike pa mapu. Zina zikhoza kukhala zobwerezedwa, maofesi, kapena nyumba zotsekedwa. Mukatsegula mpingo, tsambali limasaka chithunzi chake pa {a1}Wikimedia Commons{end} ndi Wikipedia malinga ndi malo ndi dzina, ndipo limatchula wojambulayo. Mipingo yopanda chithunzi imaonetsa chojambula. Khadi lililonse lili ndi maulalo a zithunzi, makanema ndi Street View zina.
